# FIGlet catalog notice

The archive is derived from
[`xero/figlet-fonts`](https://github.com/xero/figlet-fonts) at commit
`417429ef36ab039cbf192a4424c60aa23fc32de8`. Its deterministic SHA-256 is
`7ac92bdafd4937c8a921875272da9b33a22f34118f54a68a1cbe0e77fdba163a`.

The upstream collection has no repository-wide license. The adjacent manifest
preserves each font's embedded comment and classifies the available evidence:

- 357 entries contain attribution without an explicit redistribution grant;
- 42 entries have no usable outer notice; and
- one entry declares freeware terms.

Those classifications are audit evidence, not legal conclusions. Distribution of
the full archive remains blocked until the project owner establishes permission
or approves a distribution policy. Notices embedded in individual fonts must not
be removed.
